name: Access reviews
short_description: Recurring Microsoft Entra reviews that ask designated reviewers whether a person still needs access to a group, application, access package or privileged role, optionally applying removals automatically.

evidence.quote: The features are there. Access packages. Access reviews. Lifecycle workflows. Privileged identity management.
Access reviews belong to review. The expiration policy belongs to expire. A retention policy sits behind archive and
a quarterly access review that lives in a spreadsheet
